reviews.text:
Cal is an absolute gem in going above and beyond!

She took not only in stride but with such warmth and compassion my last minute request to board my momma cat and her three kittens with clear and prompt communication every step of the booking process to also keeping me updating on my lil fur babies throughout the duration of their stay.

I felt instantly at ease and that all of the cats were in wonderful and loving hands. I’m so happy my friend recommended her, she truly took what could have been a stressful process one into where I felt I could go into my trip feel assured.

The cats all absolutely adores her and I wouldn’t hesitate to book with her hopefully many times over the years. Thank you Cal for your care and time!

Calleigh has been an incredible sitter for our sometimes anxious bully-breed pup. After many visits and one over-night, our pup loves visiting Cal's Pals, and comes home engaged, walked, and in the end, exhausted - which is great. Solid communication and pics throughout a long visit. Will continue this relationship!

It’s always hard to leave your pup when going on vacation, but Cal made us feel so comfortable leaving her in her care while we were away. She was very responsive from the moment we first reached out to learn more about her approach to boarding dogs. She was also happy to set up a meet and greet so she could meet our pup and we could see the space where she’d be staying. Throughout our trip, we received daily photos showing how much fun our pup was having!

Cal took such great care of our pup, and we would absolutely use her boarding services again in the future.

WE LOVE CAL’S PALS! Our dog Tulip stayed with Calleigh during our wedding, and had an absolute whale of a time. Calleigh was super attentive, flexible, and we loved all the updates we got during Tulip’s stay. Our wedding was close to her place, so we were very lucky to have Tulip walked over as a surprise to our guests. Though we certainly missed our girl, we’re so glad to have a safe and happy place for Tulip to stay over whenever we need!

I would give 6 stars if I could!

We left our little cocker spaniel with Cal for over two weeks. Our dog is a very sensitive one, but she made us feel so comfortable right off the bat. We have had some not so good experiences in the last with other sitters, but now we are confident dog parents because of her! Thank you so much for taking him as if he is your own 🩷

cal is literally the best, she took care of both of our cats for about 2 weeks. they were soooooo happy with her. cal is literally a life saver, we had to leave the country due to some issues and i had to find a last minute sitter, she was not only extremely accommodating she was literally THE best, took care of our babies like they were her own, sent us daily updates which we loveddddd. i would honestly recommend her to anyone and everyone.
Cal was extremely accommodating for last minute plans, my cat was extremely comfortable. Her prices were fair for the amount of attention.

From the moment we dropped our 8 month golden off at Cal's, we knew we had left him in good hands. Cal is extremely caring, knowledgeable and dedicated to taking care of dogs, and so loving with them. When we took our puppy back a week later to be boarded for five days, he ran to Cal so quickly and didn't even look back at us. That said it all. Cal also gave us regular updates including photos and videos which was so appreciated. I highly recommend daycare or boarding your pet with Cal's pals.

Thank you Cal for taking such good care of our dog and providing us with the comfort of knowing how happy he is while we are away.

amazing! was stuck in a very stressful situation with nowhere for my baby boy to go, called with about an hour and a half’s notice and was able to drop him off and deal with my day! she sent photos of him and was overall very easy to communicate with, took great care of my bb, and is very sweet and personable 💞 i would 100% trust her with your fur baby :)

Can’t recommend Cal’s pals enough!

Our nervous dog had a great stay at Cal’s Pals. Calleigh was commutative, flexible with pickup/drop off, sent lots of photos and updates, and most importantly, made sure our pup was living his best life. Really glad we found this Calleigh.

Harvey will definitely be back!

I recently adopted Kuma and was looking for a reliable in home sitter who could care for him while I was away. I found Cal on a Google search and immediately contacted her to see we could set up a few day sessions prior to doing an extended overnight stay. Cal welcomed Kuma into her home and was very communicative along the way. Kuma fit right in and got along with the other dogs and came home in great spirits. We are so happy to have found Cal! ❤️
It was our first boarding experience and beyond giving our dog the best time - she made it so easy for us and just gets it.

Cal took great care of our cats for an extended period. We picked them up happy. It gave us great comfort knowing they were in good hands while we were away. The accommodations were great. We would happily use Cal’s Pals again!

Very kind and accommodating!
Treats your pets like family and is very good at what she does ! really saved me when I couldn’t find a good place to leave my furball sends Updates and spends time with your pet 10/10 service definitely using again thanks cal!!!!!
I loved the love they give to animals, I recommend this place without a doubt.

Calleigh took great care of my dog while I was away for a long weekend. She provides a comfortable home environment, ensures dogs that board with her have a good temperament/don’t have behavioural issues for safety, walks dogs in select groups depending on size/energy level, provides excellent communication and regular picture/text updates. Would definitely recommend!

What a great experience for our nervous little dog. Cal was patient & diligent making sure he was a good fit for her service in advance, and he absolutely was! Communication was consistent throughout his stay, complete with updates & photos of him having the best time. Highly recommend for the toronto area! They offer pickup & dropoff services too!

We couldn’t have asked for a better sitter for Wilson! She took such AMAZING care of him and was incredibly attentive to his medication schedule, making sure everything was given exactly as needed. She was also so communicative throughout his stay, which gave us complete peace of mind knowing he was so happy and well cared for.

Wilson clearly had the best time because my husband said he felt Wilson didn’t want to come home! 😂 It was so nice knowing he was in such loving and capable hands. We would absolutely recommend her and will definitely be booking with her again!

Calleigh has been absolutely amazing with our 2 year old dog Logan. We have boarded with her twice and it’s been great. This is the first time we’ve been away from him since we got him and she completely put our mind at ease, giving us updated photos and great communication throughout. She’s easy to book with and has been very adaptable to our schedule. She has great dog knowledge, and I’d highly recommend her to anyone. 🐶

Cal’s amazing. She took such great care of Franky our eight year old golden doodle. She was great, she provided regular updates, pictures and he just love being with her. Franky wants us to go away more often.
Thanks Calleigh for the worry free boarding.

Would definitely recommend Cal to anyone looking for a dog walker. Very accommodating with our somewhat anxious dog’s needs. Really easy going and flexible schedule-wise too. Good/quick communicator. Nice to work with someone chill and in the neighbourhood.

I am so grateful to have found this incredible dog boarder for my dog Lucky! Lucky is so happy to go to Cali. She has been amazing and honest and authentic through out. Lucky is always happy going and coming home! I am grateful to have someone to lean on. Highly recommend Cals pals!!!

My roommate and I needed a last minute kitty daycare, and we were both terribly stressed about it! But Cal was incredibly accommodating, both picking up and dropping off our girls, and in giving us regular updates about their stay. She made it stress free for us and for the cats, and I’d highly recommend her to anyone else!!
Cal is phenomenal! My pup loves her and is always so clearly well taken care of while in Cal's care. Cal's Pals is such a gift to the Toronto community! Can't recommend her services enough :)
Was so happy knowing our pup was looked after with lots of love and attention. We appreciated the frequent updates and pictures and prompt communication. Thank you Calleigh!

Our family was on a road trip from the East Coast to the West Coast and stopped in Toronto for some sightseeing. We found several pet boarding places, but Cal's Pals responded much faster than the others. Calleigh contacted us right away and was incredibly sweet, kind, and patient. She took the time to explain everything and kept us updated with photos of our dog and cat, which gave us so much peace of mind.
When we picked them up, they were happy, healthy, and clearly well cared for. We truly appreciate the excellent care. We can't recommend her enough.A++++++ (Chew Chew  & O O ) 🥰

We were away for a couple of weeks and were very nervous about leaving Maple & Miso behind, but Cal made the whole experience so much easier. She treated our cats like they were her own, sent lots of updates and photos, and was always quick to respond to any messages.

The biggest thing was the peace of mind she gave us. Once we knew our girls were settled, we stopped worrying because we knew they were in such good hands. We came home to two happy, well-loved cats, and we couldn’t be more grateful. We would absolutely recommend her to anyone looking for a caring and reliable pet sitter!

Highly recommend Cal's Pals! We recently boarded our dog with Calleigh for a week and it was clear that she gave him a ton of love, care, and attention. She was highly responsive and communicative with us while we were out of town, and the pictures and videos were greatly appreciated. We'll definitely be using her services again.
Calleigh is incredible. She’s looked after our pets several times and we couldn’t be happier. We recommend her to anyone looking for a reliable and friendly pet sitter

We can't recommend Calleigh enough! She has cared for our dog when we are out of town, including trips lasting up to two weeks, and every experience has been amazing.

Our dog is always happy, well cared for, and excited to see her. One of the things that means the most to us is how much his confidence around other dogs has improved while staying with her. He used to be very awkward around other dogs, and now he has even made a dog friend! Seeing him so comfortable and happy has been wonderful.

Cal gives us complete peace of mind whenever we travel, knowing our dog is safe, loved, and having a great time. We are incredibly grateful for her care and would highly recommend her to anyone looking for someone trustworthy and genuinely caring.

Cal’s incredibly responsive, accommodating, kind and provides excellent updates. I always know my pup is in the best of hands, and my dog comes home so happy every time after every walk or overnight. 5/5

So glad we were able to find Callie for our new rescue. We needed to find a sitter for when we go away a few times a year and we wanted to make sure we wouldn’t need to resort to kennel boarding since our dog isn’t great in a crate. Callie’s home style pet sitting was perfect for our scaredy cat pup. We  really appreciated that to our dog it felt like he was over at a friend’s. Not just that, but she was able to drop him off at ours when we got back which meant a lot since no one likes to come back to a quiet home.

I cannot recommend her enough! We loved seeing the updates of him settling in and becoming a part of the pack quickly and we were able to go way with peace of mind knowing he was in great hands.

We left our 6 year old husky with Cal for three weeks. We had never done boarding before as I did not feel too comfortable with the idea. In the past we had left her with friends and family. However, with this being a longer trip, we decided to explore the idea. I had read Cal's reviews and decided to give her a call. She was incredible warm and professional from the get go. I explained my hesitancy and she suggested a one night trial. We did it and it went very well, which eased some of my anxiety so we moved forward with booking for three weeks of boarding.

Mirabelle had a great time. It was clear that Cal had taken the time to make her feel comfortable. Cal was timely with sending regular updates and photo so I never felt like I didn't know what was going on or like I had to reach out to her for an update. Knowing that Mirabelle was in such good hands also let us fully enjoy our trip without that constant worry.

I can happily advocate for boarding now and for Cal's services! I am thrilled that we decided to do this and will definitely be going to Cal for the future!
Glowing recommendations for Calleigh! She is wonderful with our dog Howie and is accommodating of our work schedule. Howie loves his walk days with her!

I loved working with Calleigh! She is on top of it communicative and most importantly, my dog was pulling to get into her house when we dropped her off. My dog had a great stay. We will be sure to continue to board with cals pals

I cannot recommend my dog walker highly enough. During one of the most difficult and unpredictable times in my life — a serious health emergency during pregnancy — she stepped in and cared for my beloved dog with extraordinary professionalism, kindness, and compassion.

What amazed me most was that we had never even met in person. After just one phone call, I immediately felt completely comfortable trusting her with my dog. Her calm nature, knowledge, confidence, and obvious experience gave me such peace of mind at a time when my life felt incredibly uncertain. Knowing my dog was safe, loved, and cared for allowed me to focus on my health without constant worry.

She treated my dog with genuine care and attention, and it was clear from the beginning that this wasn’t “just a job” to her. She has an incredible understanding of dogs and a natural ability to make both pets and owners feel secure and supported.
I am endlessly grateful for her reliability, compassion, communication, and the exceptional level of care she provided during a time of real need.

Anyone would be lucky to have her care for their dog. I recommend her wholeheartedly and without hesitation.

Cal was absolutely amazing with my anxious rescue who had never stayed with anyone else before. She kept me updated to ensure I knew my dog was safe and comfortable. Couldn’t have asked for a better experience, would definitely recommend!
Cal's Pals is amazing; we trusted them with our anxious dog who did so well under their care. Would recommend!
Cal is the best and she is so trusted and reliable!

Cal was able to accommodate our last minute and take care of our cat Nutmeg for a night. Cal was flexible, super communicative and took great care of her! She gave us updates as to how she was doing and when we picked her up, our little shy girl was well taken care of. Thank you Cal’s Pal’s!!

Cal was the perfect dog boarding solution to our 3 week vacation. She's quick to respond and booking was nice and easy. Most importantly, Cal gave our active dog the attention she needed and provided us regular updates so we could feel completely at ease while on our trip. Would highly recommend to anyone considering dog boarding services in the area.

Cal is absolutely wonderful and my golden girl loved staying with her. Cal took the time to learn about all her habits and needs. She sent over frequent updates and made the whole experience low stress.

We needed  a sitter for a week for our dog, and was nervous to leave her with someone else for the first time. Calleigh was so wonderful and making sure Millie was well taken care of  and loved. We really appreciated all of the pictures and updates we received through out the week. We will absolutely only trust Calleigh with watching our dog from now on and would highly recommend Cal's Pals!

It was our first visit with Cal and Cara was immediately welcomed into Cal’s home and treated like family. Communication with us was regular, with photos and updates during our time away. Cara was able to play with the other pets in Cal’s care and clearly had a great time. Highly recommend Cal’s services!

Great experience with Calleigh. I called short notice (aka the day before) and she was able to accommodate our two cats for the day.

Would recommend and will for sure reach out for future cat sitting!

We had an amazing experience having Callie watch our pup! We get a bit nervous leaving her and felt so comfortable with her, she followed all our instructions and sent us daily updates. Overall amazing experience!!

Would 100% recommend for your pet! Cal is very trustworthy and very good with my dog, she sends regular updates with photos and takes very good care of him. I’ve had absolutely no issues and I have been to her many times and will continue to go with her!
Very friendly and responsive! Would use Cal's Pals again!

Calleigh has been so dependable walking our two pups the last few months . I feel very reassured when I go to work that they will be taken care of. She is also very flexible as my schedule is not always consistent week to week.

So I took a leap of faith and had my cats boarded overnight with Cal and I’m so happy I did. They were so well taken care of by Cal that when they came home they didn’t miss a beat. One of my cats is very vocal when displeased with me and this time just joy. Cal sent videos and photos which made it all the better. I know it’s hard to trust someone with an important member of your family but without any hesitation I’d highly recommend her services. Thanks again Cal. We really appreciate your help. Oh and for those who might have issues with transit she offers pick up and drop off.
She was very nice and good with her communication and updates. I boarded my cats for one night and I would definitely use her service again.
Amazing experience with Cals Pets. Karma our little dorkie absolutely loved it and the care and attention she recieved was unparalleled. Highly highly recommend

We boarded our 2 cats here for a week and had a great experience. The process was smooth to book their stay and get the information we needed. There was excellent communication leading up and during the stay filled with pictures and updates about how they were settling in. We loved that they had a whole room to themselves instead of a tiny kennel that you would get elsewhere. The flexible drop off and pick up times were also appreciated. We got our kitties back happy and healthy. The rates are very reasonable, especially for the space and quality of care provided for the animals. We will certainly be back in the future!

Calleigh took such wonderful care of my dog Griffin while we were out of the country over Christmas. She sent lots of photos and regular updates, which completely put my mind at ease and assured me he was happy, safe, and well cared for. It’s such a relief to know I have a place I truly trust to leave my dog without worrying. I couldn’t be happier and would recommend her without hesitation.

Our care plans for our chihuahua fell through while we were visiting Toronto and Calleigh was able to come through for us last minute with replacement care. Incredibly responsive, kind, and professional, Cal was able to charm our little shy guy. I’ll definitely be a returning client in future visits to the city!

My 8 month old puppy had the pleasure of staying with calleigh for a night. She took amazing care of him and gave us lots of picture updates. It was very clear she cares a lot about the dogs in her care.

Cal took such good care of our little puppy! Cal provided us regular pictures and updates through the day; it was abundantly clear that our little girl was happy, comfortable, and well taken care of throughout her stay.

We needed emergency boarding for 6 hours for our 3 cats while our apartment was fumigated, and Cal’s Pals picked up my first call right away. She had them booked in and I received a quote within an hour. She was super friendly and professional and I felt great about leaving my cats with her! Over the phone she ironed out all the details and asked all the right questions so it went very smooth. If I need cat boarding I’ll definitely be reaching out again!

I can’t say enough good things about Calleigh! She’s been absolutely amazing with my dog! She is always reliable, caring, and great at communicating. I completely trust her and know my pup is in great hands every time. She goes above and beyond to make sure my dog gets the best care and attention on their walks, and she’s always been super flexible and helpful with scheduling. I feel so lucky to have found her!
Cal took great care of my cat on very short notice! Would highly recommend and will be coming back!

Cal’s Pals did an amazing job caring for my cats, Bandit and Luna. While they were boarded overnight with Cal’s Pals, I received regular updates via text, including photos, of both cats.Cal spent one on one to help them, earning their trust and affection. I trust Cal to care for my cats again if need arises and I am grateful for the care provided to them!
Callie took great care of my cute cat for a day. Was very responsive and affirming, also sent tons of updates during the day. Definitely book with her when you need to trust your pets with someone.

I had a wonderful experience boarding my dog with Cal. She took amazing care of my dog and kept me updated with photos and messages, which gave me so much peace of mind. My dog came home happy and clearly loved. Highly recommend her for anyone looking for a caring home environment for their dogs.
Cal was wonderful. Edwina and Olso were well taken care of. They had a spacious room. Cal was very accommodating on an emergency basis.

I highly recommend Cal’s Pals! My cat Cheddar needed care for over a week and this was the purrfect fit for him. He had his own space and Calleigh sent lots of picture updates throughout the week. Thanks again!
Calleigh was great with our dog. She's easy to communicate with, flexible/ accommodating of our needs and provided us with regular updates. Highly recommend Calleigh's services!
For me the 5 stars are coming from my dog, who is always happy to arrive at Cal’s Pals. I love the regular updates and pics of my dog enjoying herself. Highly recommend!
My first time having my cat away from me. Cal made it soo easy and smooth. Will definitely be using the service the next time. Highly recommended

⭐ 5/5 Review for Cal's Pet Service ⭐

I am absolutely amazed by Cal’s service and truly appreciate her help! We had to leave our cats at the very last minute, and on a weekend it felt impossible to arrange anything. Cal returned my late call and immediately reassured me that she had space for them.

When I brought the cats over, they settled in right away — and we even got a video showing them enjoying their huge space with their own TV 😊. Throughout their stay, Cal sent several pictures and kept in touch, which gave us so much peace of mind.

When it was time to pick them up, they were calm, happy, and well taken care of. The drop-off location is very convenient, and the whole experience was stress-free.

If you ever need a safe, caring place for your pets, Cal is the perfect option! 🐾

Cal was super accommodating and took my cat in for a last-minute day boarding! She was very communicative from the start and made sure to send me updates on my cat throughout the day. She was super friendly, kind, and flexible with pickup and drop off times! She also seems very knowledgeable about cats, and was patient and respectful with my shy girl. 100% would recommend :)

I had a last-minute situation where I needed someone to watch my cats for the day, and I was honestly stressed. Every pet hotel I called was useless—either I had to book days in advance, fill out endless forms, or they just straight up didn’t reply. Then I found Cal's Services, and wow… she’s seriously one of a kind. I messaged her on her website around 10:30 at night—the night before I needed my cats taken care of and she replied almost instantly. Who does that?! To answer that late, be so chill and helpful, and still book me in for the very next morning? That’s phenomenal. She really goes above and beyond, and it shows. Throughout the day she sent me updates and pics of my cats, which was awesome and kept me at ease. And instead of being shoved into a tiny kennel like at other places, they had a whole room to themselves—space to hang out together, food, water, and a clean litter box. You could tell they were comfy and well taken care of. Honestly, Cal saved the day. She turned a stressful, last-minute scramble into something I didn’t even have to worry about. If you need someone who actually cares about your pets and has your back, she’s the one. Highly recommend!

I needed a place for my kitty to stay for a weekend while I had to go on a short trip, and I highly recommend this service.

Cal was very helpful though the process and was accommodating to my needs and my kitty's needs.

Cal's communication was top notch throughout the entire process and my cat's stay. Cal was very responsive to questions. Sometimes, even sending updates (with pictures) before I needed to ask how my cat was doing.

The space was a perfect size and I felt that my cat was going to be comfortable while away from me.

I will definitely be using this service again as I believe my cat enjoyed her stay and was comfortable and happy.

Callie took care of our cats for a bit during a renovation. She was amazing! Callie was friendly and loving with the cats. She sent updates everyday! We would definitely use her services again in the future!

I needed a place for my cat for a day, and that's how I came across Cal's Pals. I sent an email, and Cal replied shortly after. Cal and her sister were very reassuring when I mentioned that my cat is very nervous in new environments. Everything went well, and I even got a picture of my cat during his stay there (much appreciated)!
Cal was very accommodating of my two difficult cats, who need to be kept separated from each other.  Very happy with her services and I would recommend her to others who need their cat(s) boarded

Cal’s Pals was so easy to book with! We communicated back and forth until I had to drop off my cat Leo. He had his own room space to chill and they sent me updated photos to show he was being loved and cared for!

Calleigh is easy to deal with and super friendly. She offers a great space for my cat to enjoy to himself and relax for his stay and kept me updated on how he was doing.  Very happy to have found her service.

I recently had the pleasure of using Cal’s Pals (run by Calleigh) to board my eight-month-old puppy over the Labor Day weekend, and I cannot recommend her highly enough. My puppy is a Biewer Terrier and Shih Tzu mix with a lot of energy and separation anxiety, and Calleigh handled everything wonderfully.
From the moment I dropped my dog off on Friday until she was dropped off at home on Monday afternoon, the experience was seamless. Calleigh started with an immediate walk and carefully introduced my puppy to the other animals she was caring for, ensuring some great socialization. Each day, I received text updates and photos, which gave me complete peace of mind.
Additionally, Calleigh visited my apartment daily at the agreed time to feed and check on my cat, making sure all my pets were loved and cared for just as I would want. Everything was smooth sailing, and I returned home to happy, healthy animals.
In short, Calleigh is amazing at what she does — she’s easygoing, helpful, intuitive, and incredibly thoughtful. I’m so grateful for her services. If you need a pet sitter who goes above and beyond, I highly recommend Cal’s Pals!
Calleigh is a dog whisperer!  She is so calm, confident, and my dog adores her.  She’s very easy to communicate with and super flexible

Dropped my cat off for the day while work was being done at my place.  She was very friendly and welcoming.  My cat had her own room and I was sent photos throughout the day.  Mostly specialized in dogs but branched out because cats are great!!  Does long and short term boarding, would use again if needed

I would give Cal 10 stars if possible. Cal took such great care of our Siberian cat, and this was the first time we had ever entrusted our cat to someone. And our cat is female, so there’s always the possibility that she won’t be social or want to interact with anyone. I was more so worried that our cat wouldn’t eat or use the litter properly. I had absolutely nothing to worry about. Cal treated our cat with so much love and attention that our cat was on her own mini vacation! I could feel the care Cal took with our girl from all our interactions. We were always updated with photos and videos and when we took our cat back home she was happy and healthy! What I appreciate most about Cal - she is always open to feedback about your pet and will do her utmost to settle your fur baby in and make sure they are feeling secure. Highly Recommend!

I’ve been using Cal’s Pals consistently over the last couple of months to walk my dog. Calleigh is my dog’s walker and she is great. She provides updates with pictures after every walk, is quick to respond, flexible and has even walked my dog with little notice! Cal’s Pals is a great addition to the area and I highly recommend their services!

We feel so grateful that we found Cal’s Pals. Calleigh took great care of our 4 month old puppy. Calleigh was kind and very professional and our puppy felt comfortable with her right away. Thank you Calleigh :)

I had a last-minute emergency and Calleigh was incredibly accommodating and kind in taking in my two cats on short notice. From the start, she was personable and reassuring, making the whole process much less stressful. Kept me updated throughout their stay and communicated perfectly, which I really appreciated as a more anxious person. The room my cats stayed in was a great size with big windows, I’m sure they loved. I would highly recommend Calleigh’s services to anyone looking for a caring and reliable cat sitter!
We had an amazing experience with Cal’s Pals! Calleigh was super communicative and updated us regularly about our dog, Max, while we were away. I would highly recommend her for pet boarding!

I can’t say enough great things about Cal’s Pals. She took care of my dog for a few days and did an absolutely amazing job. From the moment we met, I could tell she truly loves animals and treats them like her own. She made sure my dog was well taken care of—daily walks, lots of love, and constant updates that gave me total peace of mind. It was clear my dog felt safe, happy, and loved with her. I wouldn’t hesitate to book with her again and highly recommend her to anyone looking for someone trustworthy and caring!

Calleigh walked our dog, Ruby for just over a year in our old neighbourhood. She was lovely, trustworthy and great with our dog. She communicated well and sent great pictures to make me feel assured that Ruby was well taken care of while I was at work.
Definitely recommend her for your walking / boarding needs!
I boarded my cats with Cal and she took great care of them! Very kind and responsive. Definitely will recommend to family and friends.

We had to board the cats for a few hours in a very short notice.  Luckily Cal had a spot for us and could  fit my kitties in. Cal is very organized, friendly and knows a lot about pets, and the price she charges is very affordable.
First time boarding our cat - great experience! I really appreciated the updates and photos that Cal provided each day. I definitely recommend her services!

I left my dog with Cal during my trip to Vancouver and she took great care of him. I was totally at ease knowing he was in good hands. I’m really happy with her service and would definitely go back to her if I need help again. Highly recommend her if you’re looking for someone caring and trustworthy to look after your dog while you’re away.

I couldn’t recommend Calleigh and Cals Pals enough. I had an out of country funeral and she was able to take my boy Casper on such short notice. Calleigh operates out of her own home which was such a relief for me as I wasn’t leaving my dog in a sterile boarding facility with a bunch of different staff. She opened her home, and her heart treating Casper like he would have been at my own home.  Calleigh was absolutely fantastic with my guy who is deaf. She was pleasant, understanding and incredibly communicative during my time away. I greatly appreciated the update pictures she sent. It was such a relief that Casper was well taken care of and visibly comfortable and happy during this time. Calleigh was wonderful and I absolutely will use her services again (under better circumstances). Thank you Calleigh!

Cal is Phenomenal! Very responsive, professional and kind. This was my first time having my cat go stay with somebody else and Cal exceeded my expectations. Got photos of my baby throughout the day and constant communication. She even worked around my schedule when needing to change pickup/dropoff times. Would highly recommend to anyone looking for a safe and loving home for their fur baby to stay at.

Cal's Pals was able to accommodate a very last-minute request which was SO helpful. They cared for my cat in their home and it was a lovely experience for both my cat and I. I picked up my happy and healthy cat 😺 and Cal was so communicative and kind, and the rate was affordable. I'll be bringing my cat back soon! …
Cal's Pal's is fantastic! highly recommend!

I'm very thankful I was able to board my dog with Cal on short notice. She was super quick to respond when I asked about booking, set up a short call before boarding to discuss my pup and sent photos and updates while he was staying with her. I appreciated how accommodating Cal was for drop off and pick up. I'd be happy to board my dog with Cal again. Thanks Cal!

Calleigh is the best with my little guy! He’s not the easiest pup on the planet. He’s a tiny herding dog with high energy and higher anxiety, and he doesn’t like many people outside his family. But he was instantly comfortable with Calleigh! And her place has become his home away from home. 🥰 …
